default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: Optional local model name (for example smollm2:135m). Never downloads a model. Overrides the WebUI global default; saved chat choices still win. Pull explicitly in Open WebUI. Applied on save.

accelerator.title: Accelerator
accelerator.description: Auto uses devices only if the host grants them; CPU fallback is expected without a grant. Effective use is reported only while a model is loaded. GPU host delivery prerequisite is not yet shipped.

context_length.title: Default context length
context_length.description: Applied when saved; affected containers restart.

keep_alive.title: Model keep-alive
keep_alive.description: 0 unloads after requests; otherwise 1–99 seconds or minutes. Save restarts Ollama.

num_parallel.title: Parallel requests
num_parallel.description: Applied when saved; affected containers restart.

max_loaded_models.title: Maximum loaded models
max_loaded_models.description: Applied when saved; affected containers restart.

max_queue.title: Maximum queued requests
max_queue.description: Applied when saved; affected containers restart.

load_timeout.title: Model load timeout
load_timeout.description: Applied when saved; affected containers restart.

flash_attention.title: Flash attention
flash_attention.description: Applied when saved; affected containers restart.

kv_cache_type.title: KV cache type
kv_cache_type.description: Quantized cache requires flash attention and supported hardware. Use f16 on CPU. Save restarts Ollama.

no_cloud.title: Disable Ollama cloud features
no_cloud.description: Applied when saved; affected containers restart.
